answer.reason: The verses tell of his reign at length, so three chief events suffice: sending out teachers, the battle at Ramothgilead, and the deliverance from Moab and Ammon.

clauses.english: sent princes and Levites to teach the law in the cities of Judah
clauses.quote: to teach in the cities of Judah

clauses.english: went to battle with Ahab at Ramothgilead and was helped by the LORD
clauses.quote: Jehoshaphat cried out, and the LORD helped him

clauses.english: sought the LORD against Moab and Ammon, who destroyed one another
clauses.quote: set himself to seek the LORD

doubts: The 1KI 22 and 2KI 3 accounts of the Ramothgilead and Moab campaigns were left out of the clauses; the Ramothgilead battle is cited from 2CH 18.
Left out as minor: the ships broken at Eziongeber and the judges he set in the land.
